messages:
sara: Quick sync — question about the /usage API contract. We currently return prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens. Is cached_tokens considered billable or just informational?
hemant: Spec note: cached_tokens were added as transparency only, not billable by default. But we didn't add a single 'billable_units' field.
marta: That ambiguity tripped up accounting on the last invoice, we had to run a manual reconciliation. :(
kevin: Accounting asks for a deterministic field. Can we add billable_units so downstream systems don't have to guess?
sara: Sounds reasonable. Proposal: billable_units = (prompt_tokens + completion_tokens) - cached_tokens. But streaming + partial cache hits might complicate this.
hemant: Streaming edgecase: runtime currently emits tokens incrementally. We only finalize cache deductions at end-of-request. For streaming clients we should document that billable_units is authoritative on final response; intermediate events may not sum to it.
accounting-bot: Reminder: any contract addition requires a migration note and SDK bump. Tagging billing owners.
marta: Would prefer keeping old fields for backcompat and adding billable_* breakdowns: billable_prompt, billable_completion, cached_count, billable_units. That keeps reconciliations explicit.
kevin: Agreed — simpler for ledger ingestion. Also add a boolean field 'billable_finalized' to indicate streaming finalization.
sara: Drafted a quick response example — happy to iterate:
```json
{
  "prompt_tokens": 120,
  "completion_tokens": 80,
  "cached_tokens": 50,
  "billable_prompt": 120,
  "billable_completion": 30,
  "cached_count": 50,
  "billable_units": 150,
  "billable_finalized": true
}
```
hemant: That aligns with runtime semantics. Implementation notes: runtime should emit cached_count per request_id and a finalization event with billable_units. We'll need to update the streaming protocol docs.
alex: Eng-runtime: will add the emitted metric and finalization flag. I can prototype the delta in the next deploy window.
sara: Thanks — I'll open a PR against the API contract with the above example and add a migration section and examples for streaming clients. @marta @kevin can you review the accounting implications when I post? :thumbsup:
marta: Will review tomorrow morning.
kevin: I'll validate with the ledger team after your PR.
eng-runtime-bot: NOTE: Filed issue ENG-4982 to add finalization emit + metric (assignee: alex)
sara: Great, marking this resolved for now — follow-up in the PR.
